newsitem.title: USA: Zygo Corp says buying Digital Instruments.
newsitem.headline: Zygo Corp says buying Digital Instruments.

text.p: Zygo Corp said Thursday that it signed a letter of intent to acquire Digital Instruments, a Santa Barbara, Calif. maker of high precision measurement products, in an all-stock deal.
Zygo said it would acquire all the outstanding stock in Digital Instruments in exchange for seven million shares of Zygo common stock.
Digital Instruments' net sales for 1996 were $50 million, Zygo said in a statement. The deal, subject to shareholder approval is expected to close before the end of this year.
